title: A line keeps its category after the category is archived
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, whose line 2 is No Charge under category A.
  • Archive category A after line 2 was marked.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Hover over the "No Charge" chip on line 2.
  3. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  4. Click "Change category".
  5. Open the "Category" select.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Line 2 still shows the chip "No Charge".
  • The chip shows only the words "No Charge", with no category name in it.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "Category: [category A's name]".

Step 3:

  • The menu shows "Change category".

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • Category A is not offered; only active categories are.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.4 (13 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E4: “If the category of a no-charge line is archived later, the line keeps it; Change category offers only active categories.”
  • S12-R3: “A no-charge line shows the chip "No Charge" next to its title on the lines table, in Tech View and on mobile, with the tooltip "Category: [category]" on hover, as the work order badge has (S2-R16); the category itself is not printed in the chip; Rate, Total and every part on it show $0.00; Margin shows nothing. Hours, technician, status, approval, parts ordering, picking, receiving, clock-ins, notes, inspections and the story work as on any line. The original work order and line are not shown on the line; they are in the notes, the Audit Log, the report and the hub record.”
